purpose: Evaluate whether a candidate returns real customer value and earns progression through first-100-user evidence without vanity promotion, manipulation, or live authority.
required_properties: customer can receive value even when no purchase occurs
vanity metrics cannot promote a candidate
manipulative or deceptive loops fail closed
customer contribution never becomes independent evidence by itself
first-100-user promotion depends on repeat use and state-dependent value
owner burden and generic-AI substitutability remain explicit failure conditions
